• M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems
• Proven technical expertise in Battery electric vehicle, electrified powertrain and HV Li-ion battery

• An eagerness to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment where you are part of a high performing team

title: Inpatient Coder
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for an Inpatient Coder for a Contract assignment with one of our premier Healthcare clients in working remote EST hours.

Responsibilities :
The Senior Coding Analyst will report to the Manager of Coding and demonstrate expertise in the coding and analysis of pediatric medical records. The Senior Coding Analyst is responsible to review, analyze, and code diagnostic and procedural information for either technical or professional services to determine the care and treatment that was provided to the patient. Will execute coding software accurately and analyze the DRG, APR DRG and AP-DRGs and support the testing of new coding programs. Will act as a resource/contact for all inpatient, outpatient, professional and same day surgery coding.
The primary function of this position is to perform ICD-10-CM/CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10-PCS (IP tech/DRG) coding for Medicare, Medicaid and private insurance payments. The coding function will ensure compliance with established coding guidelines, third party reimbursement policies, regulations and accreditation guidelines.
  • Demonstrates excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with physicians, third party payers and other organization members relative to the coding principles, logic and process.
  • Demonstrates the ability to accurately, and completely code the medical record to support reimbursement for services rendered.
  • Relies on experience and superior judgment to accomplish goals.
  • Possesses a strong understanding of all medical record processes and its contribution to third party reimbursement.
  • Maintains confidentiality of the record content at all times.
  • Assign and sequence ICD-10-CM/CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10-PCS (IP tech/DRG) codes to diagnose and procedure for documented information. Ensure the final diagnoses and operative procedures as stated by the physician are valid and complete. Abstract all necessary information from health records to identify secondary complications and co-morbid conditions.
  • Meet department accuracy and productivity standards for coding, abstracting, and record reconciliation activities.
  • Abstract all necessary information and assign ICD-10-CM/CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10-PCS (IP tech/DRG) codes, which most accurately describe each documented diagnosis, surgical procedure and special therapy or procedure according to established guidelines.
  • Identify services needing to be abstracted/coded by following prescribed procedures for the capture of inpatient and outpatient services. This may involve the use of admissions, transfer and discharge reports; appointment schedules; and/or surgical schedules.
  • Abstract applicable clinical documentation (e.g. admit report, consultation report, progress note, surgical report, etc…) for purposes of determining the appropriate billing information (e.g. provider name, date of service, CPT code, ICD-10 code, modifier(s), etc…).
  • Complete appropriate charge documents and submit to appropriate location within specified time frames.
  • Ensure all documented services are captured and coded and that all coding work is performed in a manner consistent with applicable coding rules and conventions.
  • Analyze processes and data for performance improvement and effectively communicate these findings to the manager .
  • Compile and report results of quality review work.
  • Perform a comprehensive review of the record to assure the presence of all component parts such as: patient and record identification, signatures and dates where required and other necessary data in the presence of all reports which appear to be indicated by the nature of the treatment rendered.
  • Analyze provider documentation to assure the appropriate Evaluation & Management (E & M) levels are assigned using the correct CPT code.
  • Evaluate the record for documentation consistency and adequacy. Ensure the final diagnosis accurately reflects the care and treatment rendered.
  • Review the records for compliance with established third party reimbursement agencies and special screening criteria.
Required Skills:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Coding certification required: CCS + RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, CIC,COC, CCA, or CPC-A.
  • Inpatient Coding experience
  • Pediatric coding experience

Preferred Skills:
  • Pro/Tech Coding specifically in surgical coding (Colorectal, Neurosurgery, Cardiovascular).

title: Senior GIS Specialist
description:
Software Guidance & Assistance, Inc., (SGA), is searching for a full time Senior GIS Specialist to join one of our utility clients in San Jose, CA

Position Summary

Under the general direction of the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Manager, the Senior GIS Specialist may act as a technical lead and is involved in complex tasks of utility mapping duties, performing advanced analysis, system design, and database modeling. The Sr. GIS Specialist primarily works independently, managing enterprise systems, license managers, and components of GIS platforms. Coordination with IT administrators is vital due to business system interdependencies. The Sr GIS Specialist effectively manages changing priorities and critical deadlines; performs other related work and analysis as required.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of web and mobile applications to meet user needs.
  • Configure and publish REST Services, and produce other deliverables using Esri ArcGIS 11.x related extensions and add-ons or similar software.
  • Engineer and maintain complex geoprocessing routines and ETL workbenches using FME and/or Python; automate processes to expedite routine requests extracting spatial data from various sources, transforming it to meet specific needs, and loading into publication destinations.
  • Collaborate with other senior staff to develop database and metadata standards, generating standard operating procedures.
  • Provide support in integration activities for enterprise asset management, SCADA, business intelligence, work order management, and other business systems.
  • Responsible for troubleshooting functional system issues, documenting processes, providing technical support to users, and participating in system upgrades.
  • Work with stakeholders to define requirements and select appropriate technologies considering standards, licensing, and deployment patterns.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned projects, including gathering user and system requirements, working with contractors, project managers, and internal staff.
  • Provide elevated level of support to end-users; be proactive and reactive support for critical systems; respond to and resolve incidents as they arise.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional knowledge and experience in designing, developing, and customizing mobile and web applications using Esri Enterprise (Portal, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online) or similar software.
  • Advanced ability to resolve errors, review logs, and perform modifications to ensure system reliability.
  • Ability to create data pipelines, diagnose and resolve failed processes, and prepare data across various spatial databases and SaaS products.
  • Deep understanding of geographic principles and practices; possess cartographic aptitude with the ability to complete basic mathematical and statistical calculations; advanced understanding of topological types and relationships and database design elements.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs, REST services, web requests, JSON, and XML.
  • Proficiency with scripting and code expression languages, such as Python, SQL, regular expression, and Arcade.
  • Demonstrated knowledge with data exploration or visualization tools such as ArcGIS Dashboards or Tableau.
  • Extensive experience with map production; strong cartographic skills used in presenting lateral pipeline and appurtenance data and a variety of stylized maps; strong visual and interactive design skills using Adobe Illustrator is a plus.
  • Possess the skills to work independently, organize tasks efficiently, solve problems proactively, and manage projects effectively.
  • Ability to apply Agile methodology, working closely with product delivery teams to orchestrate high-velocity product delivery.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to manage projects and maintain system documentation; successfully engage with stakeholders and colleagues to facilitate meetings.
  • Knowledge of emerging geospatial technologies including Geo AI such as machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI.
  • Committed to continuous learning and adapting to new spatial technologies and methodologies to improve skills and performance.

Required Education and Experience

  • A bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year university with major coursework in GIS, geography, computer science, data science, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
  • Five (5) years of progressively responsible professional-level experience.
  • Two (2) years of technical lead experience developing and/or maintaining enterprise applications in Esri Enterprise, Geocortex Essentials, or similar platform.
  • Two (2) years of experience with automating tasks and data manipulation tools such as FME Desktop, Python, or ArcPy.
  • Experience in authoring ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) processes, optimizing system performance, and database tuning is preferred.
  • Experience working with Oracle Spatial, PostgreSQL, and/or SQL Server databases and applications/tools (e.g., Toad for Oracle, pgAdmin).
  • Experience with project management and product development tools and bug tracking software such as Jira.

Other Requirements

  • Position requires on-call response after normal business hours for critical IT system support.
  • This position is hybrid. The employee will report to a facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days.
